text: 你悄悄引导诺曼穿过史前景观。突然，灌木发出沙沙声，你把他拉低蹲下。有什么东西——体型很大的东西——正在灌木丛中移动。它现身了。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 290
text: You silently guide Norman through the prehistoric landscape. Suddenly you hear the bushes crackle, and pull him down into a crouch. Something—something big—is moving through the undergrowth. It comes into view.
